info.title: Bulk ZIP Code Lookup API Reference
info.description: Look up multiple ZIP or postal codes in a single POST request, up to 100 codes per batch. Each matched code returns city, region, region code, locality, country code, latitude, and longitude. Accepts an optional `country` field in the request body to limit results to one country. Codes with no match are silently omitted from the `results` array instead of appearing as per-item error entries — the array can be shorter than the requested `codes` list. A malformed request body or invalid country code returns a 400; if none of the submitted codes match anything, the whole request returns a 404.

servers.description: Bulk ZIP Code Lookup API Server

post.summary: Look up multiple ZIP/postal codes in one request
post.description: Looks up up to 100 ZIP/postal codes in a single request and returns matching location data for each code that resolves.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

200.description: Successful response. `results` contains one entry per code that matched, in match order — codes with no match are omitted rather than represented as error entries, so the array can be shorter than the requested `codes` list.

partialMatch.summary: One of two requested codes matched — the unmatched code is simply absent

400.description: Bad Request — Malformed body, invalid country code, or over the 100-code limit

value.message: Request body is missing required fields or is not in the expected format. Please refer to the API documentation.

InvalidCountryCode.summary: country is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.
A maximum of 100 postal/zip codes can be processed per request.

404.description: Not Found — None of the submitted codes matched anything

value.message: None of the provided postal/zip codes were found in our database.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

ZipcodeLookupResponse.description: ZIP code lookup result containing an array of matched postal codes with location details.

results.description: Array of matched ZIP code results. Codes with no match are omitted, so this array can be shorter than the requested codes list.

ZipResultItem.description: A ZIP code result containing location details.

country_code.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

region.description: Region, state, or province associated with the postal code.

city.description: City associated with the postal code.

locality.description: Locality or neighborhood associated with the postal code. Can be an empty string when no locality-level data exists.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the postal code location.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the postal code location.

BulkZipRequest.description: Request body for bulk ZIP/postal code lookup.

codes.description: Array of ZIP or postal codes to look up. Maximum 100 codes per request.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to limit the search to. Applies to every code in the batch.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
